accepted.EXACT_REVERSAL: Exact stored current Money negated; retained even at zero.
accepted.CLAIM_REVERSED: Authorized full reversal leaves a permanent zero current claim.
accepted.ZERO_ROUNDED: A permitted code results in zero; claim identity remains consumed.
accepted.OUTCOME_APPLIED: The pinned fixed or exact-percent result is booked.

duplicate.DUPLICATE_IDENTITY: Return the exact original receipt for this accepted normalized command; no canonical append.
duplicate.DUPLICATE_CLAIM: Return the first claim receipt for the same original semantic facts under a new delivery label; no canonical append.

conflict.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Existing scoped source/delivery ID has different canonical ingress.
conflict.CLAIM_CONFLICT: The permanent target/agreement/book/family slot already has different original facts; use an explicit correction.
conflict.ALREADY_REVERSED: A stored live action already has an inverse.
conflict.STALE_CORRECTION: Correction does not name the current immutable revision ID.

rejected.OUTCOME_AUTHORITY: Verified active scoped read rights plus fresh ordinary source/submit rights are required.
rejected.CORRECTION_UNAUTHORIZED: Correction requires separately verified permission and the frozen correction source.
rejected.CORRECTION_NOT_PERMITTED: Replacement code or full reversal is not permitted by the frozen member.
rejected.OUTCOME_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Each nominated evidence reference must be retained and verified.
rejected.TERMS_NOT_VERIFIED: Original policy, assents, offers and applicable payer delegations must be verified.
rejected.TARGET_INELIGIBLE: Only the original successful base-work evaluation can become a target.
rejected.TARGET_NOT_FINAL: Base must have a final rating at target acceptance.
rejected.TARGET_REVERSED: Current base/reversal history must still show an active original target.
rejected.POLICY_OUTCOME_FAMILY: Agreement/family was not in the complete set frozen at base acceptance.
rejected.POLICY_AMBIGUOUS_MATCH: Agreement/family or code is duplicated; book/version cannot split eligibility.
rejected.POLICY_OUTCOME_CODE: Code is absent from the frozen policy.
rejected.OUTCOME_WINDOW: Occurrence must be at or after starts_at and strictly before occurs_before.
rejected.OUTCOME_DEADLINE: Receipt or acceptance exceeded its separate inclusive frozen deadline.
rejected.INVALID_ACCEPTED_ORDER: Receipt/base acceptance/current revision acceptance must not follow acceptance.
rejected.DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_BASIS: Gross active discounts exceed this binding original booked net capacity.
rejected.PREMIUM_LIMIT: Gross active premiums exceed the binding finite pinned ceiling.
rejected.PREMIUM_BOUND_REQUIRED: Every used binding requires a finite nonnegative premium ceiling.
rejected.SUPPLIER_TARGET_PATH: Supplier adjustment requires its actual nominated completion and invocation path.
rejected.EXPOSURE_EXCEEDED: Supplier premium ceiling exceeds original remaining held capacity or binding exposure.
rejected.OUTCOME_CAP_COMPOSITION: A cap in the original bundle disallows outcome target registration.
rejected.ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW: Atom, exact-rational temporary, current-net or atomic-delta bounds exceeded.
rejected.WAITING_DEPENDENCIES: Original target/base history is missing; no identity is reserved.

notes: Codes mirror semantic commit 1e0ba3f where it defines behavior; duplicate labels are candidate receipt-result encoding.
No frozen v1 reason code or HTTP mapping changes.
Internal assertion labels diagnose invariants and are not additional public reason codes.
Late reporting makes no claim that a real-world obligation vanished.
